title: Store Update 2.4.0
body:
# Store Update 2.4.0

Raiders!

Update 2.4.0 is rolling out now, bringing the Dead Eye Set along with a fix for the issue where the Raider Tool would show up as default even when a different skin was equipped. No restart is needed to get this update.

As a reminder, the team has returned to its regular schedule: store updates each week and general fixes every three weeks. The team continues to watch closely for any critical issues and keeps working on improvements.

See you Topside, The ARC Raiders Team
